 Mr. Hitesh Beherani, Advocate for the applicant.
 Coram : Manish Pitale, J.
Date : 02.08.2019.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Issue notice, returnable on 31/08/2019.
3. Learned App Mr. A.D.Sonak waives notice on behalf of the non-applicant.

4.  The applicant herein has approached this Court apprehending arrest in connection with FIR dated 03/07/2019, wherein offences have been registered against him under various provisions of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 as also sections 188, 282, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code.
5. It is pointed out by the learned counsel for the applicant that barring section 328 of the Indian KHUNTE aba532.19.odt Penal code, all the offences are bailable.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that although contraband material i.e. Pan Masala was recovered from premises with which the applicant could be connected, there was no prima facie material to connect Alla Rakha Abdul Gaffar vs State Of Maharashtra, Thr. P.S.O. P.S. ... on 2 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104928613/
1 the applicant with the said material.

entities.text: Alla Rakha Abdul Gaffar vs State Of Maharashtra, Thr. P.S.O. P.S.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was further pointed out that section 328 of the Indian Penal Code could not have been invoked in the facts of the present case.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, a case for grant of ad interim protection is made out.

7. Hence, in the event the applicant is arrested in Crime No.273 of 2019, registered in Police Station Dharni, District Amravati Gramin, he shall be released on bail on furnishing PR bond of Rs.25,000/- and a surety in the like amount.
The applicant shall cooperate with the investigation and make himself available to the Investigating Officer as and when required.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence and influence the witnesses.
8. Hamdast granted.
